scope: YouTube creator publishing and Live/Premiere planning; viewer geography, time-zone conversion, and owned-channel audience indicators kept distinct

official_findings.description: When your viewers are on YouTube is a channel-owner 28-day lookback for online activity across the service
official_findings.population: People who watch the specific channel's content, not all people of a country

official_findings.description: YouTube says publication time can help early viewing but is not known to affect long-term viewership
official_findings.population: General video upload guidance, not a country-wide audience distribution

official_findings.description: Live and Premiere occur at a shared real-world time and may benefit from audience-online scheduling
Scheduled video publication accepts date, time and time zone, while watch-page published-on date may use PST
official_findings.population: One video owned by scheduling account

official_findings.description: Low-volume geographic breakdown may omit rows even though report totals include that traffic
official_findings.population: Eligible owner Analytics reports; no realtime/private/unlisted geography

distinct_research_dimensions.note: Creator computer timezone is not automatically the viewers' time zones
Resolve daylight-saving transitions, offset and selected time zone before comparing slots
Watch-page published-on display can differ from creator's local civil date
Activity includes viewer use across all YouTube, not only visits to this channel
Privacy suppression may remove countries from the breakdown even when included in total
Do not mix public views with engaged Shorts views or changing view definitions
No causality without a defensible controlled design

format_comparison.caveat: Shorts platform view starts and engaged views must be separately defined

proposed_controlled_study.design: Pre-register within-creator comparable format, topic, language, audience market and upload-quality controls; randomize feasible release slots across matched content batches.
invalid_controls: Comparing dissimilar channels as if they share recommendation demand
Treating owner heatmap as public country population
Imputing a suppressed geography row as zero
Assuming early video lift implies higher long-term payout
Converting a watch-page PST publication date into a creator-local publication hour
Scheduling in fixed UTC offset across daylight-saving changes without resolution

acceptance_gates.reason: No consented owned-channel release-slot dataset acquired
No matched comparable topics/formats and release cohorts measured
No actual selected time zones or scheduled UTC instants observed
No randomized or defensibly controlled comparison of long-term performance
No geographic reporting coverage/withheld rows or per-format numerator measurement recorded

publication_policy: No universal best publication hour can be claimed from these sources.
Keep privacy-suppressed geography cells unknown, not zero.
Do not extrapolate private owner Analytics to public competitor channels or country-wide populations.
Use an IANA time zone and a full UTC instant for any later schedule comparison; never infer from language or viewer nationality.
Mark early viewing correlations separately from long-term causal performance.
